looks.title: Four rays
looks.intent: The four arm ends fire out along their arms, rising 40° — in haze, four rays leaving the DJ in four directions, the crowd ray coming at you; the column beams stand as the nave in cold white. The three inner beams out.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red only, and low: the columns and the press glow from their feet, the seven beams on the X stand still and dim in red, the DJ a dark shape against the red press.

looks.title: Strobe hit
looks.intent: The peak: the pit strobes rake up over the crowd from the floor, the two under the X hit the front of the floor; every beam and PAR out.

looks.title: Blackout + the cross
looks.intent: Everything out but the bridge arm's two end beams, crossing in an X 1.6 m over the DJ's head and landing in the pit either side: the DJ framed by the cross, no beam through him.

looks.title: The sign
looks.intent: All seven beams lie down along the arms: the bridge arm's four just under the horizon (under the crane's cab and trolley), the crowd arm's rising 8° over the heads, the back one over the press — in haze the X is drawn in the air, out past the truss toward the walls; the column beams out, the columns a low red, the bridge a dim red frame. Held, not swept (the X is hung: no fast or periodic head moves).
